Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work first links plating-induced stress heterogeneity to Zn dendrite initiation via chemical-potential gradients. A stress-relieving additive enables (100)-textured Zn, homogenizing compressive stress and suppressing dendrites, yielding 3500 h symmetric-cell cycling and over 10,000 cycles in Zn||I2 cells. It offers a stress-regulation strategy for dendrite-free metal anodes.

تنظیم الکترواستاتیکی تکامل فضایی گوگرد با ناهم‌ساختار BN/CNT برای باتری لیتیوم-گوگرد پایدار با ظرفیت ۱۱۵۰ mAh/g پس از ۵۰۰ چرخه.
Small | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This work introduces electrostatic regulation of sulfur spatial evolution via BN/CNT heterostructures, separating polar and conductive domains to control polysulfide interactions. Amine functionalization tailors interfacial charge, enabling homogeneous sulfur redistribution and near-zero cathode swelling. The design achieves 1150 mAh g⁻¹ over 500 cycles, establishing a new principle for dimensionally stable Li–S batteries beyond adsorption-centric strategies.
🏷 lithium-sulfur battery · BN/CNT heterostructure · polysulfide regulation · cathode swelling · electrostatic regulation

item.title: Self‐Reconstructing, Conductive Bismuth Organic Framework Enables Effective Alloying and High‐Capacity Potassium‐Ion Anodes
item.description:
آند باتری یون پتاسیم بر پایه MOF بیسموت رسانا با لیگاند HHTP، با آلیاژسازی برگشت‌پذیر و ظرفیت بالا و کاهش چهاربرابری انبساط الکترود.
Small | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 Conductive 2D Bi-HHTP MOF enables confined K–Bi alloying with reversible framework disassembly/reassembly, buffering strain and cutting expansion fourfold versus Bi powder. Its intrinsic conductivity avoids carbon additives, delivering high capacity and outperforming 3D Bi-MOFs and Cu/Ni/Co analogues, establishing design guidelines for alloy-type potassium-ion anodes.
🏷 potassium-ion battery · bismuth MOF · alloying anode · conductive framework · self-reconstruction

item.title: A Molecular Capsule to Confine Redox‐Active Metal Acetylacetonate Complex for Long‐Lifetime Non‐Aqueous Redox Flow Battery
item.description:
کپسول مولکولی TBC8 با محصور کردن کمپلکس‌های استیل‌استونات فلزی، حلالیت و پایداری الکترولیت را افزایش داده و عمر باتری جریان ردوکس غیرآبی را بهبود می‌بخشد.
Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty is using a dimeric 4-tert-butylcalix[8]arene molecular capsule to encapsulate metal acetylacetonate redox species, boosting solubility and stability. This significantly advances non-aqueous redox flow batteries, achieving 90.41% capacity retention after 1000 cycles versus 52.2% after 400 cycles without capsules, offering a promising strategy for long-lifetime, high-performance grid-scale energy storage.
🏷 redox flow battery · molecular capsule · metal acetylacetonate · non-aqueous electrolyte · capacity retention

item.title: Endogenous Functional Group Engineering Enables High‐Efficiency Hard Carbon Anodes for Sodium‐ion Batteries
item.description:
مهندسی گروه‌های عاملی درون‌زا در پیش‌ماده کربن سخت، شیمی SEI و عملکرد آند باتری یون-سدیم را با بازدهی کولمبی اولیه ۸۷.۹٪ بهبود می‌دهد.
Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers molecular precursor engineering to tune endogenous functional groups in hard carbon anodes, directly controlling SEI chemistry. It reveals that ‐COOH groups yield a thin NaF-rich SEI, enabling 87.9% initial Coulombic efficiency and 95.7% capacity retention after 200 cycles. This provides a generalizable design principle linking precursor chemistry to interfacial control for high-performance sodium-ion batteries.
🏷 hard carbon anode · sodium-ion battery · solid electrolyte interphase · functional groups · initial Coulombic efficiency

item.title: Interface and Substrate Design Enhance the Stability of Sodium Metal Anodes
item.description:
طراحی SEI و اصلاح جمع‌کننده جریان با کربن سخت، پایداری آند فلز سدیم را در باتری بدون آند با الکترولیت ژلی بهبود می‌دهد.
Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work uniquely combines SnF₂-initiated THF polymerization, forming a fluoride/NaₓSnᵧ-rich SEI, with a micron-sized hard carbon current collector. This dual strategy yields a high Na⁺ transference number (0.88), a 4.5 V window, and 1700 h symmetric-cell cycling. The resulting anode-less sodium battery retains 80% capacity after 180 cycles at room temperature and 84% after 200 cycles at −10°C, advancing practical sodium metal batteries.
🏷 sodium metal anode · solid electrolyte interphase · hard carbon · gel electrolyte · anode-less battery
